name: The Father's Estate
source:
You get to stay at a mansion with three beautiful girls. Their father wants to know to whom he should leave the family fortune. Will you help him? Will you be influence by the girls?

[From [url=https://mpallmann.itch.io/the-fathers-estate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation: 你将住进一座宅邸，那里有3位美丽的女孩。她们的父亲想知道该把家族财产留给谁。你会帮助他吗？会受女孩们影响吗？[引自[url=https://mpallmann.itch.io/the-fathers-estate]Itch.io[/url]]
